evidence.quote:
But one of the main drivers of these fluctuations is perceptions about interest rate policy
 in the different parts of the world.

So the reason we have seen a lot of this decline here, so the reason for the rise here
 of the dollar is mostly because investors in general
 perceived that the US was more advanced in its business
 cycle.

 in the different parts of the world.

So the reason we have seen a lot of this decline here, so the reason for the rise here
 of the dollar is mostly because investors in general
 perceived that the US was more advanced in its business
 cycle.

It began to tighten interest rates
 before the rest of the world.

And since interest rates were rising in the US,
 that led to an appreciation of the dollar
 by a mechanism they described at the end
 of the previous lecture.
